li.p: The headlamps remain on for approximately 5 minutes if the vehicle is in OFF position with the headlamps ON.
The headlamps turn off after 15 seconds if the driver door is opened and closed.
The headlamps remain on for approximately 5 minutes if the vehicle is in OFF position with the headlamps ON.
The headlamps turn off after 15 seconds if the driver door is opened and closed.
Vehicle is in the OFF position and the driver door is opened and closed.

note.p: If the driver gets out of the vehicle through a door other than the driver’s door, the battery saver function will not operate and the headlamp escort function will not be disengaged, so the battery may be discharged. When exiting through a door other than the driver’s door, be sure to turn off the lights of the vehicle before exiting.
